topic: Brain energy use: 20% of resting energy, 20 watts, child brain glucose
hook: Your brain burns 20% of your energy
caption:
Your brain is only about 2% of your body weight, but at rest it uses about 20% of your energy. That works out to roughly 20 watts, all day and all night.

The twist: thinking hard barely changes that number. Most of the energy goes to keeping billions of neurons ready to fire. In young children it gets even more extreme. Around age 5, the brain takes about two-thirds of the body's resting glucose (Kuzawa et al., PNAS 2014).

Follow for one fact about your body your brain won't believe, every day. Which surprised you more: the 20 watts or the 66%?
